sources.title: Download industrial emissions and waste transfer (UK PRTR) data
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.surface: GOV.UK annual UK PRTR XML datasets
sources.status: 2024 UK PRTR XML dataset published; historical annual XML datasets also available
sources.verified_fact: The official publication provides the 2024 UK PRTR dataset as XML and retains prior reporting-year downloads.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a current industrial facility emissions and waste-transfer crosscheck surface; threshold reporting means absence is not zero emissions.
sources.licence_note: GOV.UK publication terms apply; resource-level reuse terms must be checked before production ingestion.

sources.title: UK Pollutant Release and Transfer Register data sets
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.surface: GOV.UK UK PRTR scope, quality and method guidance
sources.status: Facility geography, reporting thresholds, regulator quality checks and M/C/E/U method codes documented
sources.verified_fact: The guidance states that records include facility geographic location and that operator data undergo permit, inspection and monitoring crosschecks; reported values may be measured, calculated, estimated or unspecified.
sources.quality_effect: Adds explicit interpretation and quality controls, preventing non-reporting or threshold gaps from being treated as measured zero.
sources.licence_note: Public GOV.UK guidance; no authentication required.

sources.title: Annual CO2 emissions from regulated installation operators
sources.surface: National Data Library official England installation emissions workbook
sources.status: Annual CO2e for England installations holding greenhouse-gas emissions permits; EPSG:27700 metadata and OGL stated
sources.verified_fact: The dataset describes annual CO2-equivalent emissions from regulated installation operators in England and identifies an annual update cycle and EPSG:27700 spatial metadata.
sources.quality_effect: Adds England-specific regulated-installation crosschecks; the historical coverage period and licence metadata must be preserved.
sources.licence_note: Open Government Licence; source metadata describes historical 2013-2020 coverage and ETSWAP lineage.

sources.title: UK ETS Public Reports
sources.status: Installation account-holder and allocation reports plus 2021-2025 compliance emissions and surrender report available
sources.verified_fact: The public registry provides installation operator/account-holder and allocation workbooks and a compliance report covering emissions and surrendered UK allowances for scheme years 2021-2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds installation identity and verified compliance-emissions crosschecks without implying coordinates or parcel assignment.
sources.licence_note: Official public registry report surface; workbook-specific reuse terms must be checked before ingestion.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data
sources.status: Current selectors, national inventory, machine-readable files, point-source, gridded and map products catalogued
sources.verified_fact: The official catalogue identifies the current inventory products and publication cycles, including point sources, gridded emissions and local-authority mapping.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an authoritative release catalogue for freshness and version reconciliation across all NAEI-derived candidates.
sources.licence_note: NAEI official public page; downstream product constraints remain product-specific.

sources.title: Maps
sources.surface: Official emissions map and spatial-download catalogue
sources.status: 1x1 km, local-authority and individual-site mapping surfaces documented; OGL licensing statement present
sources.verified_fact: The map catalogue states that emissions are available at 1x1 km resolution, local-authority level and individual sites where possible, and links point, grid and LULUCF spatial products.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a single authoritative map index for spatial-product completeness checks; resolution limits remain explicit.
sources.licence_note: Published under the Open Government Licence except where a product states otherwise.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions: final
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: National Data Library accredited official statistics
sources.status: Final UK territorial greenhouse-gas estimates from 1990, with source, end-user and SIC releases
sources.verified_fact: The accredited official statistics provide final UK territorial totals by source and additional end-user and SIC breakdowns.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national control totals and category reconciliation only; it is not a facility or parcel spatial source.
